FN-AIRESQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 243
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/01/2023
Senate Bill 243 as introduced could increase the obligations of governmental agencies who fail
to timely respond to survey locate requests pursuant to the provisions of this bill, dependent
upon the cost to hire a third-party to conduct a survey locate request.
